title: President of the Galaxy V2
tagline: More human. More fingers. Same impossible office.
provenance: Q888 human drawing over the original AI-generated figure | Second presidential edition, 2026
imageAlt: President of the Galaxy V2: white hand-drawn mushroom figure over an AI-generated robotic body, two raised middle fingers and rearranged orange lettering on black
description:
The second presidential edition leaves the original AI-generated body partially visible beneath a much stronger Q888 drawing layer. White linework, gold fragments and orange typography interrupt the polished machine surface, while an additional middle finger doubles the available Peace On diplomacy.

The words have also been unscrewed. Their order is now negotiable. GALAXY, TOGETHER, SCREW, PRESIDENT and STARS can be read correctly. They can also be read differently. Both readings have presidential approval.

Ten stickers. Same impossible political ambition. The original V1 remains available as a separate sticker edition and as a poster; it appears below for comparison.
